title: Autosense not working: always 100% with flat line in overview.
symptom: Autosense is always showing at 100% with sensitivity on overview as a flat line, while sensitivity changes a lot during the day as confirmed by deviation and deviation slope.
cause: Origin of the problem is about ORef1 autosense reset when cancelling a temp % profile.
evidence_quote: Origin of the problem is about ORef1 autosense reset when cancelling a temp % profile.
